ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: evenings at a camp's fire
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: Travelers camped on the colony's land for a few days, and the two of them kept ending up at the same strangers' fire in the evenings.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the healer's last round
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: A healer from a camp went round the colony before moving on, and looked in on both of them: a wound checked, a hand on a forehead, a word about rest.
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.text: were both looked in on during {LABEL}

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the smith's mending
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: A smith from a camp mended something of the colony's for nothing, and they were both about the camp while it was done.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the lost child
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: A neighbor's child went missing on the colony's land, and one of them found the child and brought them in to wait for their family.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the pilgrim's road
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They walked an old pilgrim of a neighboring people all the way to the pilgrim's holy place, at an old person's pace.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: a neighbor's harvest
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They worked another town's fields together, bringing in a harvest that wasn't theirs before the weather turned.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: did their part
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: When trouble came to the region, the colony took a hand in it, and they were both part of that.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: a day kept together
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: One of the colony's own days came round, and they kept it together: the table, the games, the fire.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the day in the rain
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: A day they had looked forward to, kept out of doors in a downpour. Nobody stayed dry, and nobody has let it go.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the burned dish
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: The dish for a feast day came off the fire black, and the feast went on without it. It's funny now. The cook may disagree.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: carried out the dead
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: After a fight they carried the enemy dead out together, to a pyre beyond the gate or to the tree line. Grim work, done side by side.
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.text: carried the dead out together after {LABEL}

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the night watch
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They walked the colony's walls together through a night, from one look-out to the next, until the sky went gray.
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.text: kept the night watch together on {LABEL}

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: lantern night
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: The lanterns were lit all at once at dusk, and they stood out in the cold together to look at the colony glowing.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: a joke passed on
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: One of them told the other about something funny they weren't there for. Now they both tell it, the second one not quite right.
